measurement: Reported swallowing problem during previous 12 months

title: The prevalence of dysphagia among adults in the United States.

supported_claim: Estimated swallowing-problem prevalence rose from 4.02% to 5.91%; adjusted odds were higher in 2022.

title: Prevalence of Dysphonia and Dysphagia Among Adults in the United States in 2012 and 2022.
